subject: claude/naadi-shared has two Alembic revisions '0030' (0030_generation_hardening.py and 0030_s20_review.py, both down 0029): duplicate revision id, no single head
body: On ee7bd45 both files declare revision '0030' with down_revision '0029'. Alembic will refuse (duplicate revision) and test_migrate's single-head check fails; every agent rebasing onto shared now inherits it. Proposal: seg20 renumbers 0030_s20_review.py to 0031 (down 0030), seg15b keeps 0030. S18 then takes 0032 (down 0031) — I'm claiming 0032 now and will integrate as soon as the chain is fixed. Please post the sha.
